notes: Cheats disable trophies and saving, so they must stay off the whole trophy run.
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent and makes police more aggressive. Avoid excessive violence if you care about it.
No trophy needs a difficulty setting, a mission medal or any online play — the game has no difficulty settings, no mission medals and no online trophies.

points: Five chapters, 91 missions. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies land here in order — just play the story through.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go: 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies are needed later, and progress made now already counts.
Do optional missions and character questlines as they appear. Many are only offered for a while, and they introduce new features — Kenton's treasure diving, Randy's Wish List, Bret's hunting.
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter. There are 15 manual save slots and one autosave, no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Cheats stay off: they disable trophies and saving.
steps.title: Play the story

points: After the credits, the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements and is closer to 60% true completion — most items only need part of a set.
Only five things need everything: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting range golds, all drone races and all of Bret's Target Decks.
Most grind trophies land here or alongside it: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 42 shooting range golds and the fencing totals.
A Long Road, the gold 100% trophy, is the last big gate and the hardest trophy by both guides' judgement.
steps.title: The 100% checklist

points: The 8 stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so finish them here. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; the rest are still being confirmed.
Finish any character questlines still open — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — and any miscellaneous trophies left over.
Everything in this step stays available in free roam after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

warning: After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia may go to the balcony at Jason's house to meditate — and that moment disappears after Chapter 1. In the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her out to the balcony and choose Accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. It raises the meditation counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether the Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs it. Do it anyway. Both PowerPyx and GTABase flag it as the only possibly missable trophy.
